errors.state.terms_of_use.text: Microsoft wants {account} to accept updated terms. Choose Sign in again, accept the terms in the window that opens, then close it.
errors.state.terms_of_use.note: Unreadable-state notice on Overview or run details. account is the account label chosen by the user or the localized default label. Keep the recovery steps clear.

errors.state.signed_out.text: {account} is signed out of Microsoft. Open Accounts and choose Sign in again.
errors.state.signed_out.note: Unreadable-state notice on Overview or run details. account is the user's account label or localized default label. Sign in again names the Accounts action.

errors.state.page_blank.text: The Rewards page stayed empty, so nothing could be read. The next check tries again.
errors.state.page_blank.note: Unreadable-state notice on Overview or run details. No placeholders. Explain that an empty page is unknown, not zero points.

errors.state.sections.text: Part of the Rewards page could not be read: {sections}. The next check tries again.
errors.state.sections.note: Partial unreadable-state notice on Overview or run details. sections is an already localized and formatted list of unreadable page sections.

errors.browser.edge_missing.text: Microsoft Edge was not found on this PC. Install Edge, or pick msedge.exe under Settings, Advanced.
errors.browser.edge_missing.note: Browser-start failure in live progress, run details, sign-in or a notification. No placeholders. Keep the executable name unchanged.

errors.browser.driver_missing.text: The Edge driver could not be found or downloaded. Check your internet connection, or pick msedgedriver.exe under Settings, Advanced.
errors.browser.driver_missing.note: Browser-start failure in live progress, run details, sign-in or a notification. No placeholders. Keep the executable name unchanged.

errors.browser.driver_mismatch.text: The Edge driver does not match your Edge version. Clear the driver path under Settings, Advanced, so the right driver is downloaded.
errors.browser.driver_mismatch.note: Browser-start failure in live progress, run details, sign-in or a notification. No placeholders. Clearing a custom driver path enables automatic driver download.

errors.browser.profile_in_use.text: This account's browser is still open. Close every Edge window of this account and try again.
errors.browser.profile_in_use.note: Browser-start or profile-migration failure in Accounts or run details. No placeholders. Ask the user to close only this account's windows.

errors.browser.edge_exited.text: Edge closed right after it started. Close any Edge window of this account and try again. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics under Settings, Advanced.
errors.browser.edge_exited.note: Browser-start failure in live progress, run details, sign-in or a notification. No placeholders. Preserve both recovery actions.

errors.browser.profile_unwritable.text: The browser data folder cannot be written. Pick another data folder under Settings, Advanced.
errors.browser.profile_unwritable.note: Browser-start failure in live progress, run details, sign-in or a notification. No placeholders. Data folder names the Advanced setting.

errors.browser.unknown.text: Edge did not start. Close any Edge window of this account and try again. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics under Settings, Advanced.
errors.browser.unknown.note: Unclassified browser-start failure in live progress, run details, sign-in or a notification. No placeholders. Ask the user to close this account's windows and retry before exporting diagnostics.

errors.task.not_available.text: Not offered on your account right now.
errors.task.not_available.note: Short reason under a task in Live run or History. No placeholders. This is a normal skip, not a failure.

errors.task.not_ready.text: The page was too slow to load this part.
errors.task.not_ready.note: Short reason under a timed-out task in Live run or History. No placeholders.

errors.task.element_missing.text: Stopped part way because the page changed.
errors.task.element_missing.note: Short reason under a task in Live run or History when a page element disappeared. No placeholders.

errors.task.quota_short.text: Not all search points came through.
errors.task.quota_short.note: Short reason under the searches task in Live run or History when the app sent its searches but the search points stayed below the daily maximum. No placeholders. Say that the points did not all arrive, never that the searches failed to send.

errors.task.browser_closed.text: The browser window closed during this task.
errors.task.browser_closed.note: Short reason under a task in Live run or History. No placeholders.

errors.task.offline.note: Short reason under a task in Live run or History. No placeholders.

errors.task.error.text: Something went wrong on the page. The next run tries this task again.
errors.task.error.note: Short reason under an unclassified failed task in Live run or History. No placeholders. Explain the next retry without inventing a cause.

errors.task.turned_off.note: Short reason under a disabled task in Live run or History. No placeholders. This is an intentional skip.

errors.task.stopped.text: The run was stopped before this task.
errors.task.stopped.note: Short reason under an unreached task after a stopped run. No placeholders.

errors.task.not_run.text: Did not run, because the run ended early.
errors.task.not_run.note: Short reason under an unreached task after an ended run. No placeholders.

errors.warning.llm_unavailable.text: Your AI for search terms did not answer, so built-in search terms were used.
errors.warning.llm_unavailable.note: Warning banner in run details. No placeholders. The fallback means the run can continue.

errors.warning.search_terms_unavailable.text: No source of search terms could be reached, so a built-in word list was used.
errors.warning.search_terms_unavailable.note: Warning banner in run details. No placeholders. The fallback means the run can continue.

errors.warning.signed_out.text: {account} looked signed out during the run. Open Accounts and choose Sign in again.
errors.warning.signed_out.note: Warning banner in run details or a notification. account is the user's account label or localized default label. Preserve the uncertainty in looked signed out.

errors.warning.daily_set_partial.text: The daily set showed fewer activities than usual.
errors.warning.daily_set_partial.note: Warning banner in run details. No placeholders. Do not claim the missing activities failed.

errors.warning.edge_version_unknown.text: Your Edge version could not be read, so this hidden run may have looked automated. If this keeps happening, set Browser window to Visible under Settings, Run.
errors.warning.edge_version_unknown.note: Warning in run details when a hidden run could not read the installed Edge version and so kept the browser's own headless name. No placeholders. Name Browser window, Visible and Settings, Run exactly as the Settings screen does.

errors.run.ok.note: Run result in History, Live run or a notification. No placeholders. Keep it short.

errors.run.partial.note: Run result in History, Live run or a notification. No placeholders. Keep it short.

errors.run.failed.text: The run could not do its tasks.
errors.run.failed.note: Run result in History, Live run or a notification. No placeholders.

errors.run.skipped.text: Nothing worth a run was open.
errors.run.skipped.note: Skipped-check result in History or Live run. No placeholders. This is not a failed run.

errors.run.checked.note: Read-only check result in History or Live run. No placeholders. No task was done.

errors.run.stopped.note: Run result in History or Live run. No placeholders.

errors.run.busy.note: Run result in History or Live run when the browser lock was held. No placeholders.

errors.run.crashed.text: The run stopped unexpectedly. Try Run now again. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics under Settings, Advanced.
errors.run.crashed.note: Run result in History, Live run or a notification. No placeholders. Run now names the action to retry; technical detail stays separate.

errors.run.config_error.text: The account list in the settings is not valid. Open Accounts to fix it.
errors.run.config_error.note: Run result in History, Live run or a notification. No placeholders. Accounts names the screen.

errors.run.interrupted.text: The run ended early, for example because the PC went to sleep or shut down, or it took longer than allowed.
errors.run.interrupted.note: Derived run result in History when no final record exists. No placeholders. These are examples, not a measured cause.

errors.run.unknown.text: This run was recorded by a newer version of the app. Update the app to see it.
errors.run.unknown.note: Run result in History when the record schema is newer than the app supports. No placeholders. Updating the app is the recovery action.

errors.decision.enough_open.note: Automatic-check decision in History or run details. points is the numeric open-points estimate, selects the plural and is formatted by the runtime.

errors.decision.quest_unlocked.note: Automatic-check decision in History or run details. No placeholders. This can start a run below the normal points threshold.

forms.one: Only {points} point was open, fewer than {min_points}.
forms.other: Only {points} points were open, fewer than {min_points}.

errors.decision.below_threshold.note: Skipped automatic-check decision in History or run details. points is the numeric open-points estimate and selects the plural. min_points is the configured threshold, already formatted.

errors.decision.nothing_open.note: Skipped automatic-check decision in History or run details. No placeholders.

errors.decision.unreadable.text: The Rewards page could not be read, so this check did not start a run.
errors.decision.unreadable.note: Skipped automatic-check decision in History or run details. No placeholders. Unknown does not mean nothing is open.

errors.decision.unreadable_run_anyway.text: The Rewards page could not be read, so the run went ahead anyway.
errors.decision.unreadable_run_anyway.note: Fixed-time check decision in History or run details. No placeholders. Explain that the configured fallback chose to run.

errors.app.internal.text: Something went wrong in the app. Export diagnostics under Settings, Advanced, if it keeps happening.
errors.app.internal.note: Bridge error shown as a toast, banner or dialog. No placeholders. Do not include technical exception text.

errors.app.bad_request.text: Something went wrong in the app. Try again. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics under Settings, Advanced.
errors.app.bad_request.note: Bridge error shown as a toast, banner or dialog. No placeholders. Offer retry and diagnostics without blaming the user.

errors.app.run_busy.text: A run is going right now. Wait for it to finish, or stop it on the Live run page.
errors.app.run_busy.note: Bridge error when starting a run or changing profiles while a run is active. No placeholders. Live run names the screen.

errors.app.run_not_active.note: Bridge error when a stop request races a finished run. No placeholders.

errors.app.run_not_stoppable.text: This run was started outside the app, so it can't be stopped from here.
errors.app.run_not_stoppable.note: Bridge error after a stop request for a run whose lock has no app supervisor. Shown in Live run or a toast. No placeholders. Explain the stop limitation without implying that the run ended.

errors.app.run_no_accounts.note: Bridge error when starting a run without an active account. No placeholders.

errors.app.run_unknown.text: This run is no longer in the history.
errors.app.run_unknown.note: Bridge error when opening a pruned or unknown run or its log. No placeholders.

errors.app.settings_invalid.text: Some settings need a fix. Check the marked fields.
errors.app.settings_invalid.note: Bridge error summary after saving invalid settings. No placeholders. Field-specific errors appear beside the controls.

errors.app.schedule_failed.text: Windows did not accept the schedule. Try again. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics under Settings, Advanced.
errors.app.schedule_failed.note: Bridge error after schedule registration or removal fails, shown in Setup or Settings. No placeholders. Retry comes before exporting diagnostics.

errors.app.schedule_legacy_not_found.text: The older daily task is gone already.
errors.app.schedule_legacy_not_found.note: Bridge error when replacing a legacy scheduled task that no longer exists. No placeholders.

errors.app.accounts_unknown.note: Bridge error after an account action races removal. No placeholders.

errors.app.accounts_migration_needed.text: To add a second account, your current account moves into a folder of its own. It stays signed in.
errors.app.accounts_migration_needed.note: Confirmation dialog before moving the single root browser profile. No placeholders. Preserve the reassurance about the current sign-in.

errors.app.accounts_last_active.text: At least one account has to stay active. To stop all runs, set the schedule to Manual.
errors.app.accounts_last_active.note: Bridge error when pausing the last active account. No placeholders. Manual names the schedule mode.

errors.app.accounts_root_needs_delete.text: This account can only be removed together with its browser data.
errors.app.accounts_root_needs_delete.note: Bridge error when removing the legacy root account without deleting its data. No placeholders.

errors.app.accounts_signin_active.text: A sign-in window is already open. Finish or cancel it first.
errors.app.accounts_signin_active.note: Bridge error when requesting a second sign-in flow. No placeholders.

errors.app.accounts_legacy_not_found.text: The earlier install could not be found anymore.
errors.app.accounts_legacy_not_found.note: Bridge error when importing a legacy install that disappeared. No placeholders.

errors.app.ollama_unreachable.text: Ollama did not answer at this address. Start Ollama, or check the address.
errors.app.ollama_unreachable.note: Bridge error when listing local AI models in Settings. No placeholders. Keep Ollama unchanged.

errors.app.url_not_allowed.text: The app does not open this link.
errors.app.url_not_allowed.note: Bridge error when a link fails the external URL allowlist. No placeholders. Do not display the rejected URL.

errors.app.updates_failed.text: Could not check for updates. The app tries again tomorrow.
errors.app.updates_failed.note: Bridge error from a manual update check in Settings. No placeholders.

errors.app.diagnostics_failed.text: The diagnostics file could not be written. Try another folder.
errors.app.diagnostics_failed.note: Bridge error after exporting diagnostics in Advanced Settings. No placeholders.

errors.app.autostart_failed.text: Windows did not accept the start-up setting.
errors.app.autostart_failed.note: Bridge error after saving Start with Windows in Settings. No placeholders.

errors.app.accounts_recycle_failed.text: The account is removed, but its browser data could not go to the Recycle Bin. It is still in {path}.
errors.app.accounts_recycle_failed.note: Warning after account removal succeeds but some browser data stays. path is the remaining browser-data folder, already supplied as a string. Use the official localized Windows name for Recycle Bin.

errors.app.accounts_root_recycle_failed.text: The browser data could not go to the Recycle Bin, so this account stays. Close Edge and try again.
errors.app.accounts_root_recycle_failed.note: Blocking error when removing the root account leaves Local State in place. No placeholders. The account is still present; do not say it was removed.

errors.app.accounts_add_unsupported.text: A second account isn't supported yet, because Edge would connect it to the account you already use. Your current account keeps working.
errors.app.accounts_add_unsupported.note: Shown on the Accounts screen where the add action would be once an account exists, and after a refused add. No placeholders. Explain the limitation without assuming how Windows is signed in or implying that existing accounts stop working.

errors.settings.window_order.text: The end time has to be later than the start time.
errors.settings.window_order.note: Inline error beside the schedule time-window controls. No placeholders.

forms.one: The time window is too short for {checks} check.
forms.other: The time window is too short for {checks} checks.

errors.settings.window_too_short.note: Inline error beside the schedule time-window controls. checks is the numeric configured checks per day, selects the plural and is formatted by the runtime.

errors.settings.days_empty.note: Inline error beside the schedule weekday picker. No placeholders.

errors.settings.url_invalid.text: This is not a web address the app can use.
errors.settings.url_invalid.note: Inline error beside a webhook or local AI address in Settings. No placeholders.

errors.settings.https_required.text: Use an address that starts with https://.
errors.settings.https_required.note: Inline error beside the Discord webhook address in Settings. No placeholders. Keep https:// unchanged.

errors.settings.file_missing.note: Inline error beside a custom Edge or driver executable path in Advanced Settings. No placeholders.

errors.settings.file_wrong_name.note: Inline error beside a custom executable path in Advanced Settings. name is the required executable filename, msedge.exe or msedgedriver.exe; never translate it.

errors.settings.folder_invalid.note: Inline error beside the browser data folder in Advanced Settings. No placeholders.

errors.settings.tasks_all_off.text: At least one task has to stay on.
errors.settings.tasks_all_off.note: Inline error beside task switches in Run Settings. No placeholders.

errors.settings.key_required.note: Inline error beside the OpenRouter API key field in Run Settings. No placeholders. Never put a key value into this message.

errors.settings.model_required.note: Inline error beside the AI model selector in Run Settings. No placeholders.

errors.settings.run_active.text: Wait until the current run ends to change this.
errors.settings.run_active.note: Inline error beside a setting that cannot change during a run. No placeholders.

errors.settings.out_of_range.note: Inline error beside a numeric setting. min and max are inclusive allowed bounds, already formatted for the user's region.

errors.settings.dollar_brace.text: This value cannot contain a $ sign right before a curly bracket. Remove one of them.
errors.settings.dollar_brace.note: Inline error beside a setting value containing a dollar sign immediately followed by an opening curly bracket. No placeholders. Keep $ unchanged and describe the bracket in words; literal braces are forbidden in catalogs.
